D/ CORN SALONINA AVG ; R/ CONCORDIA AVGG

A Roman copper alloy coin: radiate of Salonina (AD258-60). Reverse: CONCORDIA AVGG, Gallienus, togate, standing right, clasping hands with Salonina standing left. Syrian mint. Sear (2005:326 no. 10630) RIC 63. Obverse: Diademed and draped bust right Obverse inscription: CORN SALONINA AVG Reverse: Gallienus, togate, standing right, clasping hands with Salonina standing left. Reverse inscription: CONCORDIA AVGG Die axis measurement: 11.00. Dimensions: diameter: 20.88mm; weight: 2.73g. Reference: Sear, D. R. 2005. Roman coins and their values. Volume 3. Spinks: London
